gate.title: Can you read this?
gate.sub: No pressure — this just picks the right first step.
gate.noHint: Start with Hangul — no test needed

quiz.question: question {n}
quiz.stopsEarly: stops early once your level is clear

result.title: Your seed is planted
result.stoppedAt: We stopped at {level} — that's your next goal.

signup.title: Keep your spot
signup.googleFast: Fastest — no email to wait for
signup.agree: I agree to the <link>Terms and Privacy Policy</link>.

confirm.title: Enter your code
confirm.sub: We emailed an 8-digit code to {email}. Type it below — just this once. After that, your password is all you need.
confirm.sentAgain: Sent again — give it a minute.

saving.title: Planting your seed…
saving.sub: Saving {level} and opening your first lesson.

errors.authFailed: That didn't work. Request a new code and try again.
errors.rateLimit: Sorry — we've hit tonight's hourly email limit while we're still testing. Please try again in about an hour, or continue with Google instead.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.badCode: That code didn't work. Check it, or tap Resend for a new one.
errors.exists: That email already has an account — log in instead.
errors.badEmail: That doesn't look like an email address. Check it and try again.
errors.tooSoon: A code was just sent to that address. Wait a minute before asking for another.
errors.tooManyTries: Too many wrong codes. Tap Resend to get a fresh one and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
errors.notConfirmed: This email isn't confirmed yet. Enter the code we sent, or tap Resend.
errors.badCredentials: That email and password don't match. One more try, or reset your password from the login page.
errors.noAccount: We couldn't find an account for that email.
